第十五章 山途独行雾锁迷途（第1页）
踏入青云浅山腹地，山林愈发幽深，参天古树枝繁叶茂，遮挡住全部天光，林间光线昏暗，终日不见阳光。地面铺满厚厚的腐叶，踩上去松软无声，空气潮湿阴冷，夹杂着草木腐朽与泥土混杂的气息，呼吸之间都觉得胸闷压抑。
按照历练规矩，众人以三人为一组，分头采摘灵草、猎杀低阶妖兽，日落时分在山脚汇合即可。
同门弟子纷纷组队结伴，很快四散分开，转眼间林间只剩下陈默、小雪，以及始终孤身一人的旁支少女。
少女没有主动上前组队，也没有四处争抢灵草，只是独自走向偏僻无人的山沟地带，弯腰寻找那些生长在阴暗角落、无人在意的普通低阶灵草。她深知自己灵力微薄，争抢不过旁人，索性避开人群，只求安稳完成历练任务，安安稳稳返回林家即可。
她行走林间格外谨慎，每一步都小心翼翼，目光扫视四周草丛与树梢，时刻警惕潜藏的危险。从小在底层挣扎求生，无人庇护，她早已练就极强的求生本能，能提前察觉妖兽异动、灵气波动，一次次避开暗处蛰伏的凶险。
陈默始终与她保持数步距离，不远不近跟随。
他看着少女瘦弱的身影在荒草间穿梭，看着她捡到一株灵草便小心翼翼放进布袋，看着她遇见低级妖兽便立刻侧身躲藏，步步退让，从不主动争斗。他心底了然，这个女孩这一生，从来都只会避让，从来不敢争抢分毫。
他暗中出手，悄无声息斩杀暗处突袭的毒虫、低阶妖兽，清理干净痕迹，不让少女察觉，也不让她被妖兽惊扰。小雪贴着陈默脚踝行走，鼻尖时不时嗅闻林间气息，一双狐眼警惕扫视四方，默默守护着主人。
时至正午，天色骤然暗沉，狂风席卷整片山林。
原本清爽的山风瞬间变得阴冷刺骨，白茫茫的浓雾从山谷底部疯狂翻涌而上，不过片刻，浓雾笼罩整片浅山，能见度不足三尺，眼前万物都化作模糊虚影。雾气冰冷刺骨，不同于寻常水雾，吸入肺中便觉得神魂发沉，四肢僵硬，一缕淡淡的阴邪煞气混杂在浓雾之中，悄无声息侵蚀肉身。
突如其来的大雾彻底打乱所有历练弟子的节奏，林间瞬间响起慌乱的呼喊声、脚步声，同门众人惊慌失措，各自慌乱逃窜，彻底四散分离。
陈默第一时间上前，将少女护在身后，抬手运转灵力，撑起一层薄薄的灵气屏障，隔绝阴冷雾气。
少女脸色发白，下意识靠近陈默半步，眼底藏着难以掩饰的慌乱。她经历过乱世流离，最怕这种未知又凶险的恶劣环境，可她依旧没有开口求助，只是攥紧手中布包，强迫自己冷静下来。
大雾漫天，方向彻底迷失，原路彻底被浓雾覆盖，根本无法辨别归途。耳边风声呼啸，夹杂着细碎又幽怨的低声呜咽，断断续续，听得人心神不宁，汗毛直立。
“不能原地停留，雾气煞气越来越重，久留会损伤神魂。”
陈默第一次主动开口，声音平静沉稳，打破一路以来的沉默。
少女抬头看向他，轻轻点头，眼底多了一丝依靠。

两人别无选择，只能顺着煞气最稀薄的方向缓步前行，试图走出这片漫天浓雾。一路前行，周遭树木愈发荒芜阴冷，草木发黑，灵气污浊，周遭死寂一片，连虫鸣鸟叫都彻底消失。
辗转半个时辰，两人彻底偏离青云浅山历练范围，无意间踏入了整片青阳城修士都避之不及的禁地——黑风峡谷外围。
峡谷入口阴风大作，黑雾更浓，滔天阴煞从谷内翻涌而出，即便隔着很远，都能感受到谷底藏着的致命凶险。
前路迷雾重重，身后归途尽失，绝境已然降临。

Chapter 15: Wandering Alone in the Mountains and Lost in the Fog (Page 1)
Stepping into the hinterland of Qingyun Qianshan, the forest becomes darker and deeper, with towering ancient branches and lush leaves, blocking all the skylight. The light in the forest is dim, and there is no sunlight all day long. The ground is covered with thick rotten leaves, which are soft and silent when stepped on. The air is damp and cold, mixed with the smell of decaying vegetation and soil, and you feel chest tightness and depression every time you breathe.
According to the training rules, everyone is divided into groups of three to pick spiritual herbs and hunt low-level monsters, and then meet at the foot of the mountain at sunset.
The fellow disciples formed teams one after another and soon dispersed. In the blink of an eye, only Chen Mo, Xiaoxue, and the girl from the side branch were left alone in the forest.
The girl did not take the initiative to form a team, nor did she go around fighting for spiritual herbs. She just walked to the remote and uninhabited ravine area alone, bending down to look for ordinary low-level spiritual herbs that grew in dark corners that no one cared about. She knew very well that her spiritual power was meager and she couldn't compete with others, so she simply avoided the crowd, just to complete the training mission safely and return to the Lin family safely.
She was extremely cautious when walking in the forest, taking every step carefully. She scanned the surrounding grass and treetops, always alert to potential dangers. She has been struggling to survive at the bottom since she was a child, with no one to protect her. She has already developed a strong survival instinct. She can detect the movements of monsters and spiritual energy fluctuations in advance, and avoid the dangers lurking in the dark time and time again.
Chen Mo always kept a few steps away from her, following her neither far nor close.
He watched the girl's thin figure shuttle among the weeds, watched her pick up a spiritual grass and put it carefully into the bag, watched her immediately hide sideways when encountering low-level monsters, give in step by step, and never take the initiative to fight. He knew deep down in his heart that this girl had always only given way in her life, and never dared to fight for anything.
He took action secretly, quietly killing the poisonous insects and low-level monsters that suddenly appeared in the dark, and cleaning up the traces without letting the girl notice or being disturbed by the monsters. Xiaoxue walked close to Chen Mo's ankles, smelling the scent of the forest from time to time with the tip of her nose. A pair of fox eyes scanned the surroundings vigilantly, silently guarding her master.
At noon, the sky suddenly darkened, and strong winds swept through the entire mountain forest.
The originally refreshing mountain breeze instantly turned bitingly cold, and a thick white fog surged crazily from the bottom of the valley. Within a moment, the thick fog enveloped the entire shallow mountain, with visibility less than three feet, and everything in front of the eyes turned into blurry shadows. The mist is cold and biting. It is different from ordinary water mist. When you inhale the lungs, you will feel your soul sinking and your limbs stiff. A faint evil spirit is mixed in the thick mist, silently corroding the body.
The sudden heavy fog completely disrupted the rhythm of all the training disciples. Panic shouts and footsteps suddenly sounded in the forest. Everyone in the same sect panicked and fled in panic, completely separated.
Chen Mo stepped forward immediately, protecting the girl behind him, raising his hand to use his spiritual energy to prop up a thin spiritual energy barrier to isolate the cold mist.
The girl's face turned pale, and she subconsciously took half a step closer to Chen Mo, with unconcealable panic hidden in her eyes. She had experienced being displaced in troubled times, and was most afraid of this unknown and dangerous environment. However, she still did not ask for help. She just tightened the cloth bag in her hand and forced herself to calm down.
The sky was filled with heavy fog, and the direction was completely lost. The original road was completely covered by thick fog, making it impossible to identify the way back. The wind howled in my ears, mixed with thin and resentful low sobs, intermittently, which made people feel restless and make the hairs on their backs stand on end.
"You can't stay where you are. The mist is getting heavier and heavier. Staying for a long time will damage your soul."
Chen Mo took the initiative to speak for the first time, his voice was calm and steady, breaking the silence all the way.
The girl looked up at him and nodded slightly, with a hint of dependence in her eyes.
The two of them had no choice but to slowly follow the direction of the weakest evil spirit.I walked forward, trying to get out of this dense fog. As we walked forward, the surrounding trees became more and more desolate and cold, the grass and trees turned black, the spiritual energy was filthy, and the surroundings were completely silent. Even the chirping of insects and birds completely disappeared.
After wandering around for half an hour, the two of them completely deviated from the Qingyun Qianshan experience range, and inadvertently stepped into the forbidden area that all monks in Qingyang City avoided - the outskirts of the Black Wind Canyon.
The wind is strong at the entrance of the canyon, the black fog is getting thicker, and the evil spirits are pouring out of the canyon. Even from a distance, you can feel the deadly danger hidden at the bottom of the canyon.
The road ahead is foggy, the way back behind is lost, and desperation has arrived.
